company.description:
Curious Fictions is an uncluttered, mobile-friendly site where readers can find stories. The website offers a weekly featured story chosen by Breshears, but anyone can also browse a wider selection based on the writers and genres that interest them. Before anyone dive in, the site tells how many words are in a story and how long it should take to read.

The company was founded by Tanya Breshears, a designer who previously worked for Airbnb.

items.title: Curious Fictions helps readers find (and pay for) short stories
